manifest.label: Pancreas lobules · learned

substrate.role: learned appearance; illumination-flattened observed RGB distribution, not measured albedo

base_color.role: same as substrate; no semantic layers are separable

normal.role: derived from luminance band-pass height at authored mm amplitude

roughness.role: authored organ roughness 0.44 with bounded luminance-detail modulation; not measured

height.role: luminance band-pass; authored amplitude; darker = lower; not measured

layers.role: empty authored overlay; generated features are inseparable in substrate
empty authored overlay; generated features are inseparable in substrate
empty authored overlay; generated features are inseparable in substrate

layers.meaning: uniform authored wet coat (coverage 1, opacity = recipe wetness); not a learned or measured film

sample.negative_prompt: blurry, text, watermark, surgical instrument, border, cartoon, illustration
sample.seamless: circular padding in all padded UNet/VAE convolutions
sample.meaning: learned appearance sample (illumination-flattened observed RGB distribution); not measured albedo, not patient anatomy

provenance.scale_policy: authored 10.0 px/mm working scale; source frames are uncalibrated

rights.licence_conflict: Repository CC-BY-4.0; paper Usage Notes says non-commercial usage
rights.attribution: Carstens et al., Scientific Data 10, 3 (2023), DSAD, CC BY 4.0

limitations: Learned from illumination-flattened surgical RGB; base colour is not measured albedo
Native learned detail is 512² at about 10 px/mm; larger maps add no measured detail
Height, normal and roughness are derived or authored, not measured
No vessel/fascia/adipose layer separation; overlays are empty
No subsurface scattering recovery; wet coat is a rendering approximation
Not clinically qualified; no surgeon review
manifest.qualification: learned appearance pilot; visual and held-out review required
